rows.implementation_requirement: `sifr_format` calls Ruff formatter library APIs over Sifr AST/source and returns complete formatted source.
`sifr fmt <path>` discovers `.sifr` files through Sifr project/path rules while preserving Ruff explicit-target behavior.
`sifr fmt --check` reports drift without writes and exits nonzero on drift.
Ruff diff behavior is CLI-layer, not formatter-library-layer. Sifr must generate unified diffs from original/formatted text in its CLI wrapper without shelling out to Ruff.
Sifr CLI owns stdin/stdout and optional filename context, then calls the same in-process formatter API.
Add a Ruff-compatible `--range` option for one resolved file only, using the same position grammar and formatter range API.
Implement Ruff-style formatter cache behavior with cache keys covering source metadata, formatter options, Sifr version, and Sifr Ruff fork revision.
Match Ruff's file-selection behavior for Sifr paths.
Match Ruff's distinction between explicit roots and forced exclusions.
Match Ruff comma-delimited file-pattern override semantics for format file selection.
Match Ruff formatter override semantics and precedence.
Match Ruff preview toggle behavior while keeping stable style default.
Do not expose Python target-version semantics. Sifr has no formatter syntax-version flag in this phase; a future language-edition phase may add one explicitly.
Sifr formatter source kind is `.sifr` only in this phase; multiple source-kind mapping requires a later product decision.
Sifr canonical config is `sifr.toml`; Ruff config files are migration inputs only under the precedence rules below.
Sifr file discovery must support formatter include/exclude settings, `.gitignore`, and explicit target overrides.
Map directly to Ruff `PyFormatOptions` line width.
Map directly to Ruff indent width.
Map directly to Ruff indent style.
Map directly where Sifr string syntax uses Ruff-compatible string tokens.
Map directly to Ruff line-ending behavior.
Map directly for Sifr calls, collections, signatures, and type constructs that use Ruff AST layouts.
Support Ruff-recognized docstring code forms by formatting Sifr snippets with the Sifr parser/formatter. The option remains disabled by default.
Same disposition as docstring code formatting.
Expose explicit Sifr preview flag/config that maps to Ruff preview mode. Stable mode remains default.
Apply at statement level, matching Ruff/Black semantics.
Apply to preceding statement, case header, decorator, or other Ruff-supported syntactic boundary adapted to Sifr AST.
Treat as aliases for `fmt: off/on` at the same statement-level boundaries Ruff documents.
LSP `textDocument/formatting` routes through `sifr_lsp -> sifr_analysis -> sifr_format` and is advertised only when `sifr.format.enable` is true.
LSP `textDocument/rangeFormatting` routes through the same formatter context; no independent LSP/editor formatter.
Neovim, Zed, Helix, Emacs, and VS Code assets/docs must expose formatting through `sifr lsp --stdio` and standard editor LSP formatting hooks.
The extension uses the Sifr LSP client document formatting provider and format-on-save settings; extension TypeScript owns no formatter.
Add Sifr corpus checks inspired by Ruff ecosystem checks: idempotence, parser roundtrip, no panics, invalid-source diagnostics, comments/pragmas, config matrix, and performance budgets.
Sifr has no notebook product surface in this phase. A later product phase must add this explicitly if needed.
Ruff treats import sorting as lint/fix behavior, not formatting. Sifr format must not reorder imports.
